info.title: Cypress Universal API
info.description: Extract Cypress Cloud enterprise reporting data such as project usage, run status, flake trends, browser coverage, UI coverage, and accessibility metrics through the documented Data Extract API.

get.description: Retrieves accessibility score details from Cypress Cloud.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

ciBuildId.description: CI build identifier returned by Cypress.

commitAuthorName.description: Commit author name returned by Cypress.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the run was created.

projectName.description: Cypress project name returned by the report.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
